scientific_integrity: The theorem concerns Haar-probability-normalized SU(2) central characters and complex coefficients; its unrestricted maximizers and infinite-weight statements are proved analytically. Finite computation is supplementary and is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the two-character span of the trivial and one highest-weight character for integers n >= 2 and sixth moments; historical priority has not been independently audited, and a potentially relevant 1982 character-norm paper was accessible only by abstract.
title: Parity-sharp sixth-moment synthesis for the trivial and a high-weight \(SU(2)\) character
